definition: different from what is normal or usual
description: A selfie on a tropical beach covered in snow under a grey sky. A young woman with dark wavy hair, wearing a coral bikini top and a thin gold necklace, stares into the camera with her mouth open in shock as snowflakes fall. A clump of snow drops from a palm tree behind her; she shuts her eyes, looks up at the sky with her mouth open, then stares at the camera again. A thatched sun umbrella, turquoise sun loungers and a straw hat are dusted white, and the turquoise sea rolls in.

taps.phrase: to gaze up at the sky
to drop a clump of snow
